# Shape Grid

**Cover › Geometric** · v1.0.0 · 48 frames at 30 fps (24–90)

A grid of shapes scales up in a wave until they cover the frame, then shrinks away in the same direction to show the next scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/shape-grid@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/shape-grid@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Clean corporate and tech edits
- Explainers
- Section breaks

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import shapeGrid from './transitions/04-cover/geometric/shape-grid';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(shapeGrid, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 48 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in. |
| `shape` | enum | `"square"` | `square` · `circle` · `diamond` | Shape of each cell. |
| `columns` | integer | `12` | 4–32 | Cells across the frame. |
| `from` | enum | `"top-left"` | `top-left` · `center` · `left` · `top` · `random` | Where the wave starts. |
| `hold` | number | `0.1` | 0–0.4 | Share of the transition spent fully covered. |
